verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only bare accuracy claims: a bar chart of Scribe v2 beating Gemini, OpenAI and Deepgram, '35% fewer transcription errors on clinical audio', and 'industry-leading accuracy'. None names a benchmark dataset, WER methodology or reproducible evaluation, which is exactly what the story asks for. The axis applies to an STT product, so absence of methodology is 'none'.

support.subject: As a founder, published accuracy claims come with a methodology or benchmark dataset I can check, not bare marketing numbers
